title: UPS CEO：亚马逊业务下滑已成过去
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: keeping an eye on the broader markets and keeping an eye on shares of UPS down about 6 percent.
segments.zh: 关注大盘走势，UPS股价下跌约6%。

segments.en: After the company reported earnings this morning, the company did actually beat on most of the main metrics adjusted EPS above analyst estimates revenue in the quarter above analyst estimates
segments.zh: 今早财报显示，公司主要指标超预期，调整后每股收益和营收均高于分析师预估。

segments.en: in the company, boosting its full-year sales forecast as well as providing an adjusted earnings forecast ahead of analyst estimates, a testament here to a lot of changes that the CEO has made over the last

segments.en: few months to wean themselves off some of the lower margin business and move deeper into some of the higher margin products and services. Please to say that the CEO of UPS Carol Tomey, she joins us
segments.zh: 减少低利润业务，转向高利润产品和服务。有请UPS CEO Carol Tomey。

segments.en: right now on the heels of that earnings report and Carol, I do want to start off with the guidance for the rest of the year. It looks relatively strong and I know you've talked in the past

segments.en: that not only 2026 would be a good year for this company but you alluded last quarter that 2027 could potentially be even better. Are we still on track to see that? Well, Romaine, it's good to

segments.en: be with you and you know I'm delighted to say that we launched a strategic transformation of our company 18 months ago to glide down Amazon volume and reconfigure our network and we did that and then we
segments.zh: 之后恢复盈利和营收增长。全年指引显示利润和盈利将持续增长，为2027年奠定良好基础。

segments.en: returned to profit and revenue growth and as you looked at the guidance for the balance of the year we will continue to grow our profit and earnings which gives us runway for really good 2027.
